default_findings.text: src/pricing.js:4 - The loop starts at index 1 and runs while i <= items.length, so it skips the first item and reads items[items.length], which is undefined; non-empty carts throw a TypeError. Iterate from 0 while i < items.length, or restore the for...of loop.
src/pricing.js:11 - averageItemPrice divides by items.length, so an empty cart returns NaN. Return 0 or throw when items is empty.
lib/format.js:2 - formatCents divides by 10 instead of 100, so 1234 cents renders as $123.40. Divide by 100.
src/coupon.js:2 - applyCoupon treats percent as a fraction; a caller passing 20 for 20% gets a negative total. Divide percent by 100 or validate the range.
